notes: R41's clause 'compute flow figures across all the case's accounts after removing paired own-account transfers' cannot be fully met inside T33: own-account pairing (R8, R9) is T34's work, and T33 does not depend on it. compute_case already treats any line categorised own_account_transfer as out of trading receipts, M9 and the M16/M26 denominator. Once T34's pairing categorises both halves of a pair that way, the combined flows exclude them without any change here. Until then, an inter-account transfer that neither the profile nor the wording decides counts on both sides. The runner should either judge that sub-clause under T34, or make T34 a dependency of T33. I did not change the shared contract to build pairing here.
